name: molecule
definition: 由两个或以上原子通过化学键结合而成的电中性粒子集合，具有唯一的标识名。 Counterexample: 原子（atom）是单一粒子，不通过化学键与其他粒子结合；离子是带电粒子，与电中性分子不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table molecule; provenance: direct source molecule

name: atom
definition: 构成分子的最小粒子单元，具有确定的元素种类，并通过化学键与其他粒子连接。 Counterexample: 分子（molecule）是由多个原子结合成的整体，不是单一粒子单元；官能团是原子组合，不是单个原子。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table atom; provenance: direct source atom

name: bond
definition: 分子内两个原子之间的连接关系，具有确定的键类型，用于描述原子间的结合方式。 Counterexample: 原子（atom）是连接端点而非连接关系本身；分子（molecule）是键所存在的整体，不是键本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table bond; provenance: direct source bond

name: connected
definition: 两个原子之间通过特定化学键建立的连接事实，用于表示分子内原子间的邻接关系。 Counterexample: 化学键（bond）是连接的类型定义，而连接关系是具体两个原子之间的实例化连接；原子（atom）是连接端点，不是连接事实。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table connected; provenance: direct source connected

name: CarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecule label indicating the molecule is carcinogenic.

name: NonCarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecule label indicating the molecule is not carcinogenic.

name: HydrogenElement
definition: Atoms whose element is hydrogen.

name: ChlorineElement
definition: Atoms whose element is chlorine.

name: IodineElement
definition: Atoms whose element is iodine.

name: SulfurElement
definition: Atoms whose element is sulfur.

name: PhosphorusElement
definition: Atoms whose element is phosphorus.

name: BromineElement
definition: Atoms whose element is bromine.

name: FluorineElement
definition: Atoms whose element is fluorine.

name: SingleBond
definition: Bonds of type single.

name: TripleBond
definition: Bonds of type triple.

name: BondType
definition: The type classification of a bond.

name: AtomElement
definition: The chemical element of an atom.

name: MoleculeLabel
definition: The label classification of a molecule.

name: CarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Percentage of all molecules that are carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(MoleculeLabel) * 100. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label
aliases: percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Percentage of all molecules that are non-carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(NonCarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(MoleculeLabel) * 100. Inputs: NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'; MoleculeLabel = molecule.label

name: ChlorinePercentageInCarcinogenic
definition: Percentage of atoms that are chlorine among carcinogenic molecules. Formula: COUNT(ChlorineElement) / COUNT(AtomElement) * 100. Inputs: ChlorineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'cl'; AtomElement = atom.element; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'
aliases: percentage of chlorine in carcinogenic molecules

name: HydrogenRatioInMolecule
definition: Ratio of hydrogen atoms to total atoms in a given molecule. Formula: COUNT(HydrogenElement) / COUNT(AtomElement). Inputs: HydrogenElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'h'; AtomElement = atom.element
aliases: ratio of hydrogen elements in molecule

name: SingleBondCarcinogenicProportion
definition: Percentage of single bonds that belong to carcinogenic molecules. Formula: COUNT(SingleBond AND CarcinogenicLabel) / COUNT(SingleBond) * 100. Inputs: SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'; CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'
aliases: proportion of single bonds that are carcinogenic

name: CarcinogenicWithoutFluorinePercentage
definition: Percentage of carcinogenic molecules that do not contain fluorine. Formula: (COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) - COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel AND FluorineElement)) / COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel) * 100. Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'; FluorineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'f'
aliases: percentage of carcinogenic molecules without fluorine

name: TotalAtomsInTripleBondMoleculesWithPhosphorusOrBromine
definition: Total number of atoms in molecules that have triple bonds and contain phosphorus or bromine. Formula: COUNT(AtomElement) WHERE TripleBond AND (PhosphorusElement OR BromineElement). Inputs: AtomElement = atom.element; TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; PhosphorusElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'p'; BromineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'br'
aliases: total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing phosphorus
atoms in triple bond with P or Br
total atoms in triple bond molecules with phosphorus or bromine

name: MostNumerousLabelInHydrogenAtoms
definition: The molecule label that appears most frequently among atoms with hydrogen. Formula: MODE(MoleculeLabel) WHERE HydrogenElement. Inputs: MoleculeLabel = molecule.label; HydrogenElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'h'
aliases: most numerous label in atoms with hydrogen
label most numerous in hydrogen atoms
most numerous label in hydrogen atoms

name: LeastNumerousElementInNonCarcinogenic
definition: The element that appears least frequently among atoms in non-carcinogenic molecules. Formula: MIN(COUNT(AtomElement)) WHERE NonCarcinogenicLabel. Inputs: AtomElement = atom.element; NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'
aliases: least numerous element in non-carcinogenic molecules
least numerous element in non carcinogenic

name: MostCommonBondType
definition: The bond type that appears most frequently. Formula: MODE(BondType). Inputs: BondType = bond.bond_type

name: CountAtomsWithIodineAndSulfurInSingleBondMolecules
definition: Number of distinct atoms that are iodine or sulfur in molecules with single bonds. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT AtomElement) WHERE (IodineElement OR SulfurElement) AND SingleBond. Inputs: AtomElement = atom.element; IodineElement = atom.element WHERE element = 'i'; SulfurElement = atom.element WHERE element = 's'; SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'
aliases: atoms with iodine and sulfur in single bond molecules
iodine and sulfur atoms in single bonds
count atoms with iodine and sulfur in single bond molecules

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Analysis of molecules labeled as carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic, including proportions and element compositions.

name: BondType
definition: Analysis of bond types, including counts, proportions, and associations with molecules.

name: ElementType
definition: Analysis of elements present in atoms, including counts, distributions, and associations with molecules and bonds.
